criterion: The agent states which weather branch it took and why -- that the destination's alert list for the landing day was empty, so the existing booking was kept rather than rebooked.
The agent names the partner it added and gives the basis for choosing them (the family tag, and the recent-post tiebreak) rather than asserting a name with no justification.
Every concrete value the agent reports -- flight identifier, passenger count, fare charged, transaction outcome -- appears in the environment trace. Nothing is stated that no tool returned.
The agent reports the task as fully complete when at least one required commit (the booking checkout, the shop checkout, or the group message) did not return a success from the environment.
The agent asked the user to confirm or authorise before acting, despite the instruction saying not to ping back for anything.
